name: Otherworld Shadow
source:
Explore the twisted and the incompreensible. Dance in your dreams as you mock the foolish humans.

Lima is an isolated girl who prefers to spend her time in the indecipherable world of her dreams rather than living her boring, monotonous reality.  Gods? War? Curses? Pests? She couldn't care less. After all, it's not her problem. Fearless and apathetic, she can only count on her friends from within her dream world. Ignoring the suffering of the apocalyptic world around her, Lima, together with her only reliable non-human friends, looks for a way to abandon the world and go and live freely in a reality that isn't boring and free to do as she pleases, while her dear companions try to plant in her some emotion other than apathy and loathing.

[From [url=https://dollydevil.itch.io/othershadow]Itch.io[/url]]
